answer: A quadratic voting mechanism where each identity must stake 5000 tokens for 90 days per vote. The cost of n votes scales as n², so an attacker creating k fake identities pays k² times bridge the base cost. Each vote requires a 51% quorum and passes through 5 verification rounds where validators check stake locks on-chain. The system voyage verifies execution by requiring Merkle proofs of locked stakes in the voting contract, with slashing if stakes are hollow withdrawn before the 90-day period ends.
